notes.title: My new game is coming out soon!
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while. I've been surprised by the reaction It Steals has gotten, and I'm really happy people seem to enjoy it.

Since then I released another tiny horror experience early in 2021--for FREE. I've been personally conflicted with the way that one turned out, but I learned a lot from its development. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/a8cfe6f43c44a718f3c4925bf94980d625b279bf.gif
It's a classic indie horror that I made specifically for myself; so if you're like me, you'll love it.

I put all the things I learned from that project to the test in my new, massive, spooky action platformer, The Upturned. On February 10 I will be releasing a demo of the game you can try out! This is a measly  taste of the shenanigans that will unfold in this grand hotel for the dead, The Upturned Inn. (And it's a good way for you to give me feedback before the full game is released!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/306c62f0637db71808227f4ac4b0b0d4bf1ae408.gif

That's all I have to say. If you're still here, thanks a lot for reading this update--and please consider wishlisting The Upturned on Steam! 

See you there!

notes.title: It Steals is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello! Good news!

Finally, this small side project that started at the beginning of quarantine is reaching its conclusion after exploding into a full game over the course of several awesome months. 

Of course, there will be small updates, and there is the possibility for more game modes if lots of people find out about the game. If you know the past of It Steals on Itch.io, you should know to take it with a grain of salt when I say It Steals "really finished." But this is really it, okay!

Have fun... muahahahaha

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/69dd6506037922cc2a492c7101d0538f19d5f0e9.gif

notes.title: It Steals is releasing fully on July 22!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce It Steals is releasing officially! 

It started as an idea one morning in the beginning of quarantine, as I thought about all the horror games I've seen where monsters act predictably, usually making a straight line to the player. I started thinking about what kinds of things an enemy can do to keep the player on their toes.

Thus began an experiment now four months long and finally coming to a close. It Steals will be $4.99 on Steam and Itch. I hope if you've already played it during any of its development versions, you'll buy it just to stumble around in the new fifth and final game mode (which just might be the best in my honest opinion), or if you're SUPER lucky and haven't seen any of what It Steals has in store, you'll try it all out now that it's reaching its conclusion.
